description: Sumptuous new 3-bedroom flat with 3 bathrooms, fully air-conditioned.Elegant, spacious, quality furniture and bedding, professionally decorated, my flat is located in the heart of the capital. Halfway between the Marais, Beaubourg, rue Montorgueil and Place des Victoires, you are surrounded by trendy cafés and restaurants. It's the ideal place for a successful stay with family or friends.The spaceFlat of 137m2 on the 1st floor without lift including :- Air conditioning throughout the flat- Wifi Tv- Living room with double sofa bed1 office areaDining area with large dining table and 10 chairs- Fully-equipped kitchen (fridge with freezer, induction hob, microwave, oven, toaster, Nespresso coffee machine, dishwasher, washing machine with dryer option)- 1 king-size bedroom with shower room and toilet1 king-size bedroom with shower room- 1 queen-size bedroom with shower room1 separate WCThe cleaning fee includes clean sheets and towels for each guest and is carried out by a professional cleaning agent.Guest accessTravelers will have access to the entire apartmentOther things to noteADDITIONAL Services (optional)• Baby bed: Price - 60€This booking is protected with coverage for lost baggage and emergency medical expenses, provided by Swift Travel Cover with claim up to 750 Euros (T&C Applies). Full details available at booking.
